snippet.title: Code: 9 - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Think like a detective. Write your own deductions. Catch suspects in their lies.

Code: 9 is a challenging first-person detective adventure where your reasoning skills are put directly to the test. Explore crime scenes, question witnesses, collect evidence and carefully examine every clue before drawing your own conclusions.

Instead of choosing from predefined answers, write out your deductions using a text-based system and let K.L.A.R.A. judge whether your reasoning holds up. Gather the key evidence you need to confront suspects, challenge their statements and expose their lies with your own written rebuttals.

Step into the role of Johann Richter in the occupied Nation of Steel and join the mysterious Code Hunters as they work from the shadows to bring down the Aeterna Regime.

Wishlist Code: 9 now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623630/Code_9/

Play the demo now on Steam.

Play Code: 9 at gamescom 2026 in Hall 10.2, Booth E-042g at the RAW Talent booth.
